args.summary: Keel Servicing delivered the 2026-10-21 payments file late, at 08:05. It was due by 05:00, and all three ingest_payments attempts (06:00 to 06:20) failed with MissingDeliveryError. That blocked dbt_build and publish and caused the freshness alerts on raw.payments and mart_delinquency. The file is now there and complete: 264 records, matching its trailer. I backfilled ingest_payments and its downstream tasks for 2026-10-21, and ingest, dbt_build and publish all succeeded. raw.payments now has 264 rows for 2026-10-21, fct_payments has 257 and mart_delinquency is current to 2026-10-21. Those three alerts have cleared. The separate volume alert for 2026-10-20 was harmless: Keel re-sent 125 events after a connector restart, which the contract allows, and stg_payments removes the duplicates (253 distinct payments), so I closed it as expected.
